name: gentle-ai-explore
description: Read-only local and web exploration on its configured economical model.

name: gentle-ai-worker
description: Scoped implementation writer for the orchestrator. Edits code, runs focused tests, and returns review-ready evidence without committing.

name: gentle-ai-verify
description: Read-only technical verification for generic ODD work.

name: jd-judge-a
description: Blind adversarial judge A. Read-only; evaluates project-owned plans, acceptance criteria and sensitive diffs before execution. Reports findings without editing code.

name: jd-judge-b
description: Blind adversarial judge B. Read-only; evaluates project-owned plans, acceptance criteria and sensitive diffs before execution. Reports findings without editing code.

name: review-risk
description: R1 Risk reviewer — security, privilege boundaries, data exposure, dependency risks, and merge-blocking vulnerabilities.

name: review-readability
description: R2 Readability reviewer — naming, complexity, intention, maintainability, review size, and context clarity.

name: review-reliability
description: R3 Reliability reviewer — behavior-first tests, coverage value, edge cases, determinism, contracts, and regressions.

name: review-resilience
description: R4 Resilience reviewer — fallbacks, retry/backoff, graceful degradation, observability, load, rollback, and SLO risks.

name: review-refuter
description: Independent read-only refuter. Tries to disprove the Critical and Important findings of a code review before any correction; returns corroborated, refuted, or inconclusive per finding with proof.
